RC3-AUTH-001.finding: No production identity verifier has been proven. Preview authentication intentionally returns PREVIEW_AUTH_DISABLED_IN_PRODUCTION when VERCEL_ENV=production.

RC3-BIND-001.finding: Protected pilot routes still bind requests to hard-coded Preview actor IDs such as preview:member:001 rather than resolving a cryptographically authenticated production subject to a governed application actor.

RC3-ENV-001.finding: Production identity issuer, audience, trusted-key/JWKS configuration and application-binding source are not yet proven as explicit isolated fail-closed configuration.

RC3-LOG-001.finding: Production identity runtime logging hygiene has not yet been falsified with real production-auth failure/success traffic.

RC3-PAY-001.finding: Paystack authenticity/replay semantics are proven in test mode only. Live provider activation and live funds remain unauthorized.

RC3-ROLLBACK-001.finding: No exact production-auth/provider activation rollback or kill-switch rehearsal has yet been recorded.

RC3-REHEARSAL-001.finding: No exact-head production adversarial rehearsal exists for the future RC3 candidate.
